title: dactylorhiza maculata subsp. fuchsii
intro: Dactylorhiza maculata subsp. fuchsii, commonly known as the Spotted Marsh-Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza maculata subsp. fuchsii include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
